messages:
marta: Heads-up — I'm seeing unrelated rows from another org show up in my QuickTabs after I switch a filter. Repro steps: 1) open quicktab A for Org X, 2) flip to quicktab B for Org Y, 3) apply a saved filter, 4) some rows look like they're from Org X. Happens ~2/50 times for me.

alex: can repro on mac/chrome. looks like a flash — rows load then replaced by the right set, but sometimes they stick.

josh: my hunch: client cache key for quicktab snapshots doesn't include workspace/org id. we collide when tabs are fast-switched. quickcheck: search for "quicktabSnapshotKey" in client.

priya: telemetry backing this up — sampling traces show session.traceId=gh-34 has two quicktab requests with identical cache key but different X-Workspace headers. exporting a sample:
```json
{"session_id":"gh-34","reqs":[{"path":"/quicktab","cache_key":"quicktab:page:42","headers":{"X-Workspace":"org-x"}},{"path":"/quicktab","cache_key":"quicktab:page:42","headers":{"X-Workspace":"org-y"}}]}
```

alex: confirmed in code: client/src/store/quicktabs/cache.ts uses \u0060const key = `quicktab:${pageId}`\u0060. no org scoping.

josh: fix is simple in client: include workspace id. i can open a tiny PR that changes the key to: 
```js
const key = `quicktab:${workspaceId}:${pageId}`
```
but we should also add a server-side validation guard to avoid serving cached snapshots with mismatched workspace headers. defense in depth.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: noticed rollout quicktabs@2.1.4 -> prod at 2026-03-18T03:12Z. Could be when this started.

dave: agree with server guard. add check in quicktab handler: if (snapshot.workspace !== headerWorkspace) return 403 or fetch fresh. log once per request id.

marta: thanks. I'm going to open INF ticket and assign owners. mitigation plan: 1) client patch (include workspace in key) — alex (owner) 2) server guard + transient deletion of stale cache keys — josh (owner) 3) retro telemetry to find affected customers and rollback if needed — priya 4) docs+runbook update for rollouts — dave.

alex: created PR -> https://git.redwood/internal/pulls/4621 (WIP). small change + unit test.

josh: I'll send a small server PR to validate snapshot.workspace against X-Workspace and instrument a metric quicktab.mismatch_count.

priya: I'll run a query to list sessions with >1 workspace in same session window and post results here later today. early value looks like ~1.8% of active sessions in last 24h.

marta: temporary mitigation: ops can flush quicktab client cache CDN keys for the last deploy timeframe. ops, can you run flush for prefix quicktab:* deployed 2026-03-18? :pray:

infra-bot: ops-request-bot: cache-flush started for prefix quicktab: at 2026-03-20T10:05Z. will post completion.

dave: also add a canary for the client change and server guard — target 5% for 2 hours, verify mismatch_count decreases.

marta: filing INF-2489 as the canonical ticket and adding links to PRs + telemetry. Will follow up in incident channel if we see customer reports. :thumbsup:
